mods.comment: KEEP DISABLED. This NOPs the sceKernelUsleep in FrameLimiter_Update (sub_401B20). That limiter IS the 引擎's 每秒六十帧 cap: game logic advances on a fixed 60 Hz timestep (see FrameLimiter_Update interval and the per-frame tick in GameFrameLoop), so removing it lets the loop run as fast as the 机械生命体 allows and game 速度 scales with FPS (e.g. 120 FPS = 2倍速度). Disabled so the 每秒六十帧 cap stays in 原力; the 3D present is decoupled separately by the 'Uncap 3D Frame Present' mod.

memory.comment: Disable Frame Limiter: NOPs the sceKernelUsleep in FrameLimiter_Update (sub_401B20). The 引擎 stops 睡眠 toward the 每秒六十帧 deadline; frame delta-time becomes the real elapsed time (uncapped).

mods.name: Uncap framerate (Use with 60FPS patch, increases gamespeed!)

memory.comment: Decouple 3D present from vblank: NOPs the sceKernelWaitEqueue in GraphicsDevice_SubmitFlipAndWait (sub_224960). The 引擎 submits a sceVideoOutSubmitFlip every frame and then BLOCKS one vblank waiting for that flip's completion event. In 重装兵 3D (地牢/combat) render+submit just exceeds one 60Hz interval, so the 格挡 lands two vblanks later -> a 困难 30 FPS lock, while light 2D menus stay 60. Removing the 待机 lets the flip queue (bounded by flipPendingNum<3 spin) 速度 frames instead of the vblank event.
